topic: Sigg-Jimenez hardware-bilinear-merged Bicubic Catmull-Rom history resampling vs 1-tap bilinear TAA blur rig
topic_zh: Sigg-Jiménez 硬件双线性合并双三次 Catmull-Rom 历史重采样对比单抽头双线性 TAA 凡士林模糊
scope: Deterministic Sigg & Hadwiger (GPU Gems 2, 2005) / Jorge Jimenez (SIGGRAPH 2016) hardware-bilinear-merged Bicubic Catmull-Rom history resampling (s_12 = w_2/(w_1+w_2), W_12 = w_1+w_2) versus naive 1-tap bilinear history resampling and brute-force 16-tap (4x4) tensor-product bicubic evaluation across 17 sub-texel stations over K = 8 recursive TAA frames. No neural frame upscaling execution.
